summary: Digital Brands Group, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 6, 2026, announcing it retained the law firm Christian Attar to investigate potential naked short selling and market manipulation of its common stock. The company previously engaged Shareholder Intelligence Services (ShareIntel) to track shareholder data. The investigation follows an internal review of trading patterns raising concerns about securities law violations including naked shorting, spoofing, and beneficial ownership threshold breaches. The company intends to pursue legal action and provide evidence to the DOJ, SEC, and Ontario Securities Commission. No financial terms or transaction are involved; this is a corporate governance and legal action event.
